title: Ordinary prenatal-consciousness population-modelling guardrail
scope: Reusable project-level default for ordinary members of a future named human-reference population only after explicit adoption by that work's manifest; not individual diagnosis, detailed fetal phenomenology, Enuma canon, or the reincarnate protagonist.
approval_evidence: The Author explicitly selected Prenatal A and instructed that it be recorded with this bounded project-level future-setting scope on 2026-08-12.
question: How should ordinary prenatal consciousness and directed prenatal System practice be treated in future human-reference population modelling before setting-specific evidence exists?
selection: When a work manifest explicitly adopts this project default, do not deny or numerically quantify ordinary fetal sensation or automatic development, and assume no ordinary persistent self-aware continuity and no ordinary directed prenatal System practice in population modelling unless a later scoped decision supplies evidence. Keep the protagonist's reincarnate continuity separate. An independent work may override the default only through its own Author decision.
alternatives: Option A: preserve unknown ordinary sensation and automatic development while excluding ordinary persistent self-aware continuity and directed prenatal System practice from the population model; selected.
Treat ordinary fetuses as persistently self-aware System practitioners; not selected.
Deny or numerically quantify all ordinary fetal sensation and automatic development; explicitly outside this decision.
rationale: This prevents a population model from inventing widespread prenatal agency while also avoiding an unsupported claim about fetal sensation or automatic development. It preserves the protagonist's exceptional continuity as a separate mechanism.
evidence: Author selection Prenatal A and bounded-scope instruction dated 2026-08-12.
litrpg-system/cal0/canonical/litrpg-system-specification.md: natural prenatal development and protagonist reincarnate continuity are separate causal channels.
litrpg-system/cal0/guide/litrpg-system-residual-uncertainty-register.md: ordinary prenatal-consciousness distribution remains a world-level input.
consequences: Population models must not award ordinary directed prenatal System practice, its XP, or its intentional training consequences by default.
The guardrail does not deny sensation, automatic learning, maturation, or other ordinary fetal development.
The guardrail supplies no numerical prevalence or phenomenological distribution for sensation or awareness.
The protagonist's reincarnate continuity and directed prenatal practice remain a distinct exceptional scenario and do not imply ordinary prevalence.
This decision creates no named people, culture, institution, medical doctrine, religion, or setting fact.
No work inherits this guardrail silently; its manifest must cite the decision URI and adopted scope.
A work-specific override requires its own explicit Author decision and does not rewrite this project default for other works.
residual_unknowns: Ordinary fetal sensation and automatic-development distributions remain unquantified.
The future human-reference population and evidence base are not yet defined.
Setting-specific cultural, medical, magical, and institutional interpretations remain undefined.
Which future works, if any, will adopt this default remains undefined.
reopening_conditions: A named setting requires an ordinary prenatal-awareness distribution.
Evidence or a causal setting mechanism supports persistent prenatal continuity or directed practice in a defined group.
Population modelling exposes a contradiction or unusable outcome.
The Author explicitly reopens the guardrail.
